name: finwise
description: FinWise — мобильное приложение для учёта финансов (React Native + Expo + TypeScript + Express API)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,app -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run start -w client"
scripts.web: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run web -w client"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w client
